title: Orthogonal crypto book: catalogue of every earlier crypto sleeve with FROZEN definitions, selected on 2020-24 only, judged once on 2025-26
registered: 2026-10-23, before computing the catalogue's correlations or any combined number
catalogue (frozen definitions, rebuilt f: Gen261 A Upbit attention share XS
Gen274 B altcoin OI share rotation
selection (uses only data to 2024-12-31): sleeve Sharpe DEV (start..2022) > 0 AND TEST (2023-24) >= 0.5 AND |daily correlation with the v8.6 portfolio 2022-24| <= 0.25
book: selected sleeves, each scaled to equal risk by its 2020-24 daily sd, summed, then scaled to 15% vol on 2020-24 (no vol targeting)
judge (2025-01..2026-09, once): book Sharpe >= 0.8 AND |correlation with v8.6| <= 0.25 -> 'orthogonal book found'; also reported: v8.6 + book (equal risk) at both levels
honesty: every catalogue sleeve was evaluated on 2025-26 before (as an addition to the books); the selection rule and the combination are new and use only pre-2025 data, but this is not a clean out-of-sample test: a found book still needs the paper run
